## 

```{r}
#| echo: False
library(tidyverse)
library(bnlearn)
library(mgcv)
library(gratia)

```

```{r}

data = read.csv("data/ckd.csv")
head(data)
```

```{r}
data$rc = as.numeric(data$rc)
data = data|>
  select(sod, bp, sc, hemo, bu,pot, rc)


clean_data = na.omit(data)
clean_data <- type.convert(clean_data, "numeric")/100*100

clean_data

```

```{r}
dag =model2network("[bu|sod:bp][rc][hemo|rc][sc|bp][sod][pot][bp|sod:hemo:pot]")
```

```{r}
graphviz.plot(dag, shape = "ellipse")
```

```{r}
ckd_fit = bn.fit(dag, data=clean_data)

```

```{r}
##gam(hijo ~ padres)
mod_rc = lm(rc ~ 1, data = clean_data)
mod_pot = lm(pot ~ 1 , data = clean_data)
mod_sod = lm(sod ~ 1 , data = clean_data)
mod_gam_hemo = gam(hemo ~ s(rc), data = clean_data)
mod_gam_bp = gam(bp ~ s(hemo) + s(pot) + s(sod), data = clean_data)
mod_gam_sc = gam(sc ~ s(bp, k = 3), data = clean_data)
mod_gam_bu = gam(bu ~ s(bp, k = 3) + s(sod, k = 3), data = data, method = "REML")
```

```{r}
-1/2*(BIC(mod_sod)+ BIC(mod_rc) + BIC(mod_pot) + BIC(mod_gam_bp)+BIC(mod_gam_sc)+ BIC(mod_gam_bu)+BIC(mod_gam_hemo))
-1/2*(AIC(mod_sod)+ AIC(mod_rc) + AIC(mod_pot) + AIC(mod_gam_bp)+AIC(mod_gam_sc)+ AIC(mod_gam_bu)+AIC(mod_gam_hemo))
```

```{r}
#BIC
score(dag, data = clean_data, type = "bic-g")
score(dag, data = clean_data, type = "aic-g")

```
